Incident Response & Threat Intelligence Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex security incidents and investigations. Translate threat intelligence into actionable detections, threat hunting use cases, and security controls. Conduct root cause analysis and drive continuous improvement through post-incident reviews and lessons learned. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration Participate in purple team exercises and adversary simulations to validate and improve detection effectiveness. Develop security metrics, dashboards, and reports to measure cyber defence maturity and operational effectiveness. Mentor junior team members and contribute to the evolution of Cyber Defence Engineering practices and standards. Solid knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Entra ID, Identity Security, Networking, and Azure/AWS cloud environments. Experience with security automation, orchestration, and incident response processes. You will be doing regular catchups with your Manager who will act as your career coach and guide you in your career goals and aspirations. jobs.title: Lead Engineer, Agentic AI Engineering
jobs.description: About Trinity & This Role Trinity Life Sciences is a leading analytics and technology partner to the biotech and pharma industry, helping clients solve their hardest commercialisation challenges across market access, forecasting, field force, customer engagement, and real world evidence. AI Foundations is the internal team making AI adoption fast, safe, and repeatable across Trinity - building the platforms, standards, and reusable components that product teams build on. Trinity is seeking a Lead AI Engineer - Agentic Systems to take ownership of technical execution across the AI Foundations engineering team in India. This is a step up from Senior Engineer: you are still deeply hands-on, but you carry additional responsibility for how the team executes - ensuring deliverables land on time and to standard, coaching engineers on agentic and platform development approaches, and acting as the technical authority the team rallies around. The right candidate leads by doing, holds the bar high, and understands that their success is measured as much by the teams output as their own. Key Responsibilities Team Oversight & Project Execution This is the dimension that distinguishes the Lead role from Senior. You are responsible for how the team delivers, not just what you personally build. Own end-to-end delivery of agentic AI engineering workstreams - planning, prioritisation, dependency management, and ensuring deliverables complete on time and to the quality standard the business expects. Track progress across parallel workstreams; surface blockers early, escalate when needed, and remove obstacles so engineers can focus on building rather than navigating process. Maintain visibility into the health of ongoing projects: scope creep, technical debt accumulation, integration risks, and resource constraints - and act before they become problems. Coordinate with Data Scientists, product managers, and stakeholders to align on requirements, timelines, and definition of done - ensuring engineering and business expectations stay in sync throughout delivery. Run effective sprint rituals, design reviews, and retrospectives that keep the team sharp and continuously improving without adding unnecessary overhead. Architecture Standards & Technical Governance Act as the technical authority for agentic systems architecture within the India team - reviewing and approving significant design decisions, ensuring consistency with Trinitys established patterns and guardrails. Enforce adherence to engineering standards: coding conventions, testing requirements, CI/CD practices, security and RBAC patterns, and agent harness implementation - not as bureaucracy, but as the foundation that makes the team go faster over time. Own the teams reference architectures and reusable component library; keep them current as the agentic AI landscape evolves and new approaches prove themselves. Identify and address technical debt proactively - make the call on when to refactor versus when to ship, and be transparent with stakeholders about the trade-offs. Hands-On Engineering The Lead role is not a management role. You remain a significant individual contributor and the technical credibility that comes from that is what makes the rest of the role work. Architect and deliver complex agentic AI solutions end-to-end - multi-agent systems on LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK , and platforms including AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Snowflake Cortex , and Databricks Mosaic AI . Design for MCP/A2A interoperability, agent memory systems, tool registries, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints; implement agent execution harnesses with sandboxed tool execution, policy-as-code guardrails ( NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI ), and full observability via Langfuse or LangSmith . Build or integrate with full-stack enterprise applications - applying enterprise-grade security ( OAuth2, SAML, SSO, RBAC ), secrets management, audit logging, and secure API design as first-class engineering concerns. Make informed, production-tested choices on inference infrastructure ( vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM ), container orchestration ( Docker, Kubernetes / EKS / AKS ), and data tooling ( SQL, Snowflake, Databricks ). Team Growth, Mentorship & Culture Coach and mentor engineers across all levels on agentic AI development, platform engineering, and software engineering craft - investing in their growth as seriously as in the teams output. Run structured technical sessions: design reviews, architecture walkthroughs, code review standards, and knowledge-sharing forums that build collective capability in agentic and platform development. Identify skill gaps in the team and work with leadership to address them - through hiring, coaching, or deliberate project assignments that stretch engineers in the right directions. Foster a culture of ownership, high standards, and continuous improvement; be the kind of technical leader people want to work for and learn from. Contribute actively to hiring - define what good looks like for engineering roles, assess candidates rigorously, and help build a team that makes everyone in it better. Stay Current & Drive Adoption of What Works Stay ahead of the agentic AI field - evaluate new frameworks, protocols, and techniques with a critical eye and bring well-formed recommendations to the team on what is worth adopting. Champion the adoption of AI-enabled development practices that improve team productivity: code generation, automated testing, documentation tooling, and developer experience improvements. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of software engineering in production, with 4+ years in AI/ML or agentic systems - and at least 2 years in a technical lead or principal engineering capacity. Proven ability to drive delivery across a team: you have owned project timelines, managed dependencies, and ensured engineering work lands on time and to standard. Deep technical expertise across the agentic AI stack - frameworks, cloud platforms, agent safety, evaluation, inference infrastructure, and full-stack enterprise integration. Strong Python and SQL proficiency; hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production container environments. Demonstrated ability to set and uphold engineering standards - coding, testing, architecture, and security - and bring a team along with you, not just impose them. Excellent communication: able to represent technical decisions to senior leadership, align with business stakeholders, and coach engineers at every level. Passion for the agentic AI field and a genuine habit of staying current - you bring ideas to the team, not just execution. Background in life sciences, pharma, or regulated environments is a strong differentiator. Degree from IITs, NITs, BITS, or comparable; strong applied track record considered equally. The Kind of Achievements We Respect "Led a 4-person engineering team to deliver a multi-agent analytics platform on AWS Bedrock in 12 weeks. All milestones hit. Adopted by 3 product teams within a month of launch." "Introduced architecture review and testing standards across the team. Deployment-related incidents dropped by 70% in the following quarter." "Coached two engineers from mid-level to senior in 18 months through structured design reviews, paired engineering sessions, and deliberate project ownership." Why This Role Matters Trinity is building something foundational in India - a team that will shape how AI gets built and adopted across the enterprise. The Lead Engineer is the person who makes that team deliver with consistency and craft. If you are energised by the combination of deep technical work, team ownership, and genuine influence over how an AI organisation develops, we would like to meet you. jobs.description: COMPANY PROFILE Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world s most ambitious changemakers define the future. Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of shared innovation, seamless execution, underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU LL WORK WITH This position sits within an agile data engineering team, owning the quality of end-to-end data pipelines from source ingestion through medallion-layer transformation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to BI/reporting consumption. The role suits someone who thinks like a data architect and builds/tests like an engineer, equally comfortable with pipeline design and hands-on SQL, PySpark, and automated data quality frameworks. WHERE YOU LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM The engineer independently owns the data testing strategy for their workstream, including a reusable SQL validation library usable for both manual and automated checks, and constructively challenges design or process decisions that risk data integrity or delivery quality. Works closely with Data Engineers, the QA Manager, Product/Project Managers, and business stakeholders. WHAT YOU LL DO Requirement, Project and Business Understanding (20%) Develop deep expertise in the data domain and business context source systems, transformation logic, medallion layers, and downstream BI consumption. Build a thorough understanding of the pipeline lifecycle (ingestion staging transformation curated/BI layer). Review source-to-target mappings and transformation logic before test design begins. Support the team on data QA methodologies and processes, with guidance from QA leadership. Test Planning, Design, Execution, and Defect Management (35%) Own the data testing strategy across full, incremental, delta, and historical loads, including insert/update/delete/cancel and effective-dated transactions. Design and execute ETL/ELT validation, reconciliation, schema, null/completeness, and transformation test cases across the medallion architecture. Validate pipelines end-to-end source through Databricks/ADF/Spark to final BI output, confirming numbers, aggregations, and business logic tie out. Define and enforce data quality rules and build reusable checks; investigate anomalies and drive root-cause analysis with Data Engineers. Manage the defect lifecycle and prepare test evidence, quality dashboards, and RCA reporting for release sign-off. SQL Script & Automation Engineering (20%) Build and maintain a structured, version-controlled Databricks/SQL validation queries usable standalone for manual checks and pluggable into automated regression/CI without rework. Own inline maintenance of the library: refactor as schemas evolve, retire obsolete checks, keep naming and parameterization consistent, and document each scripts purpose, inputs, expected output, and edge cases so it stays usable by the wider team. Set up and maintain automated data testing frameworks (e.g., Datagaps, PySpark-based checks) that consume the library for scheduled/CI-triggered runs. Work with Data Engineers to wire validation into CI/CD, ensuring failures surface with actionable, traceable output. Collaboration (15%) Provide input into the test strategy mix (manual / automated / framework-driven) in partnership with QA leadership and data engineering. Constructively challenge decisions that risk data quality or testability and propose practical alternatives. Participate fully in agile ceremonies; raise risks and quality concerns early and clearly. Partner with the business to understand the wider data system and act as a quality partner for delivery. Leadership (10%) Own data testing deliverables, including the health of the automation/SQL library, for the workstream. Lead or contribute to QA initiatives that raise the bar on data testing practice across the team. Mentor junior testers on ETL/data testing techniques, SQL standards, and automation tooling ABOUT YOU Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, dimensional modeling, fact/dimension tables, and medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with the ability to trace a data point end-to-end into its BI report representation. Hands-on proficiency with Azure SQL/Databricks/Apache Spark (PySpark) for large-scale data validation and transformation testing. Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, linked services), Azure Storage (partitioning, Parquet/Delta), and third-party API integrations (e.g., Salesforce, etc.) Advanced SQL for backend validation and reconciliation across SQL Server/PostgreSQL/Databricks, with emphasis on writing maintainable, reusable, parameterized scripts. Working knowledge of Python for test scripting and validation automation. Practical exposure to ETL/data quality tools, Datagaps DataOps Suite (good to have), or equivalent (DQX, QuerySurge, Informatica, Talend, DataStage, SSIS). Ability to define and apply data quality rules systematically (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, timeliness). Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation or anomaly detection, with the ability to adapt checks for AI-produced and consumed data pipelines. Comfort with Agile/Kanban delivery, CI/CD practices, and defect management tooling (JIRA, Azure Boards, or similar). A curious, quality-first mindset confident to constructively challenge decisions when quality is at risk. Strong written/verbal communication and stakeholder partnership skills; strong critical thinking and independent problem-solving. Experience: 4-6 years in data testing/automation, with hands-on ETL, Data Warehouse, and/or Big Data testing experience. Proven experience testing pipelines on Databricks/Spark within a medallion or layered Lakehouse architecture. Experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure cloud storage constructs. Experience validating data through to BI/reporting layers (Power BI, Tableau, or similar), not just the warehouse layer. Experience with data quality frameworks/rule design and writing SQL validation scripts reused across both manual testing and automated regression, ideally with exposure to a tool such as Datagaps. Experience with SDLC/STLC, Agile ceremonies, and defect lifecycle management; prior ownership of a test strategy independently is strongly preferred. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing or data validation tools Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 4-6 Yrs Software testing, Consulting, Software Quality, SQL, Quality assurance, Quality, Assurance, Agile
